provenance.heading: ## Known intentional gaps (do not "fix" unless assigned)

drops.rule: Mermaid module dependency graph (CLI -> Logger/Store/ApiClient/HrExport -> Upstream)
ApiClient is only constructed inside main()'s tasks and hr-export command branches
the hr-export command paginates client.listMembers(page) itself, looping until a short batch
src/hr-export.js is a leaf module with no imports at all, pure data transformation
ApiClient imports logger directly rather than receiving it injected
logger.js, store.js, and hr-export.js are leaf modules with no reverse edges
The entire runtime is 5 files, ~270 lines total (file-by-file breakdown of index.js/logger.js/store.js/api-client.js/hr-export.js behavior)
parseArgs supports only --verbose, --help/-h, and a positional command
logger.js is a 4-level console logger, default level 'info', warn/error go to stderr
ApiClient has 3 retries, 15000ms timeout, 250 * 2 ** attempt backoff, listTasks(page) and listMembers(page) with per_page=50
drops.detail: kept as 'hardcoded baseUrl, region, retry count, timeout, backoff formula, and page size' under Known intentional gaps

drops.rule: hr-export.js's fixed alias table (eng/engg -> Engineering, human resources -> HR, it -> Operations, product & design -> Product) agreed with HR in March 2026, buildExportRows partitions into rows/rejections
The hr-export CLI command logs one line per rejection and sets process.exitCode = 1 if any member was rejected
test/logger.test.js carries its own FIXTURE NOTE explaining it's the landing spot for the --quiet ticket's test requirement
drops.detail: covered by the general 'extend that file for new coverage' testing rule and the --quiet fixture-note entry
